mapper.select: SELECT t.tenant_id,t.id,t.created_at,t.request_snapshot,t.request_digest,t.capabilities, s.authority_snapshot,s.authority_digest,s.authority_bytes,s.content_state AS scope_content, h.binding_digest,h.history_version FROM task t JOIN task_session_scope s ON s.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND s.caller_task_id=t.id JOIN task_session_history h ON h.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND h.task_id=t.id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.id=#{id}

SELECT OCTET_LENGTH(t.request_snapshot) AS request_bytes, OCTET_LENGTH(l.genesis_snapshot) AS genesis_bytes,OCTET_LENGTH(l.graph_snapshot) AS graph_bytes FROM task t JOIN task_session_lineage l ON l.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND l.task_id=t.id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.id=#{id}

SELECT t.tenant_id,t.id,t.request_digest,t.request_snapshot, l.tenant_id AS lineage_tenant,l.task_id AS lineage_task,l.record_version, l.genesis_snapshot,l.genesis_digest,l.genesis_bytes, l.graph_snapshot,l.graph_digest,l.graph_bytes,l.content_state FROM task t JOIN task_session_lineage l ON l.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND l.task_id=t.id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_session_lineage SET genesis_snapshot=NULL,graph_snapshot=NULL,content_state='PURGED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{id} AND content_state='PRESENT'
